name: Wixoi - Phase 1: Google Docs Data Extraction (stealth/crouton-alpha)
description: Monitors Wixoi Sandbox in Google Drive, reads Wixoi - Extraction Sandbox Google Doc, sends to OpenRouter stealth/crouton-alpha for zero-hallucination JSON extraction, and parses clean validated data.

mapper.body:
{
  "model": "stealth/crouton-alpha",
  "response_format": { "type": "json_object" },
  "temperature": 0.1,
  "messages": [
    {
      "role": "system",
      "content": "You are the Wixoi Extraction Engine. Extract customer names, invoice details, line items, and amounts from the provided document text into strict JSON format.

STRICT EXTRACTION RULES:
1. NEVER invent or hallucinate missing data. If a field (such as PO number, tax, due date) is absent, output null strictly.
2. Output JSON matching this schema:
{
  "customer_name": string | null,
  "vendor_name": string | null,
  "invoice_number": string | null,
  "po_number": string | null,
  "invoice_date": string | null,
  "due_date": string | null,
  "line_items": [
    {
      "description": string,
      "quantity": number | null,
      "unit_price": number | null,
      "amount": number | null
    }
  ],
  "subtotal": number | null,
  "tax": number | null,
  "total_amount": number | null,
  "currency": string | null,
  "verification_status": "VERIFIED" | "FLAGGED_FOR_HUMAN_REVIEW",
  "flags": string[]
}
3. Validate math: if sum of line items != total_amount, set verification_status to 'FLAGGED_FOR_HUMAN_REVIEW' and add reason to flags."
    },
    {
      "role": "user",
      "content": "{{2.body.content}}"
    }
  ]
}
